newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish reverse repo drains 76 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Swedish reverse repo drains 76 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday said it drained 76 billion crowns from the market in its morning reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at a fixed rate of 4.95 percent, a cut of 10 basis points from the last tender, and will run from October 9 to October 16.
It replaces an operation that drained 68 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 17.27 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
